protocol_or_search_strategy: Targeted review of NIH ODS Vitamin A and Pregnancy Health Professional Fact Sheets, accessed 2026-11-14.
inclusion_criteria: Official government nutrient and pregnancy fact sheets.

NIH ODS. Dietary Supplements and Life Stages: Pregnancy — Health Professional Fact Sheet.
risk_of_bias_tool: Not applied to government fact sheets; underlying studies and references require appraisal.
